proposedJapanesePrompt: 清潔な使い捨て手袋を着けた人が、髪を耳へ掛け直しました。次の食品に触れる前に、再手洗いや手袋交換が必要なのはなぜですか。
japaneseJudgment: Accept minimal repair. Existing stem leaves the required action unspecified (必要な理由 has no clear referent). New stem explicitly states the already-present explanation intervention 再手洗いや手袋交換, asks why it is required, and preserves the contaminated-glove correct answer. No knowledge/answer/option/order/source change.

sourceMeaning.explanationJa: 髪などへ触れた手で作業せず、再手洗いや手袋交換を行います。

sourceMeaning.knowledge: After hair contact, gloves may be contaminated. Do not continue food work with contaminated hands/gloves; rewash hands or change gloves as specified. Retain Japanese や/or alternatives without adding a new cumulative obligation.
